usage.guide: POST a standard Solana JSON-RPC body {jsonrpc:"2.0", id:1, method:"getSlot"} (or any Solana RPC method, with optional params array) to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/solana/rpc. The result comes back at body.result in standard JSON-RPC form. Payment is x402 USDC on Base at $0.0005/call (per element for batches). CAUTION: with the current QA pay tooling the payment was rejected as amount_too_low (sub-cent price below the settlement floor) and the call could not be completed — verify with a pay client that can settle 500-atomic-unit ($0.0005) amounts before relying on it.
